troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting and reporting
troubleshooting.entryGuidance: Find help with playback, missing audio in OBS, or OBS connection issues.
troubleshooting.supportPackageGuidance: Review the summary, then save the file to share with the developer.
troubleshooting.audioHelp: If OBS is silent while local audio plays, check the capture device and OBS audio source. Play a track and watch the meter.
troubleshooting.audioDeviceGuidance: The device may have been disconnected or disabled. Reconnect it or choose another device.
troubleshooting.audioGuidance: Select a device again, then check the OBS audio meter.
troubleshooting.obsHelp: To record session timestamps, open and connect to OBS, then start streaming or recording.
troubleshooting.obsWaitingGuidance: Open OBS. If it’s already open, check WebSocket and the port.
troubleshooting.obsAuthGuidance: Make sure the connection password matches your OBS WebSocket settings, then try again.
troubleshooting.obsGuidance: Enable WebSocket in OBS and verify the host and port, then try again.
troubleshooting.libraryGuidance: If a track is missing or won't play, scan for missing audio files. The scan only reads your library.
troubleshooting.exportEmpty: There are no errors or warnings to export.
troubleshooting.exportSummaryOnly: This support package contains only the event count and time range.
troubleshooting.exportEncrypted: Event categories, occurrence times, and diagnostic references are encrypted.

autoReport.title: Critical error reports
autoReport.guidance: Reports include the error type, location, and app version. Library data, lyrics, and files stay private.
